apoc.text: And the earth shall restore those that are asleep in her, and so shall the dust those that dwell in silence, and the secret places shall deliver those souls that were committed to them.
apoc.prev: And after seven days the world, that yet awakes not, shall be raised up, and that shall die that is corrupt
apoc.next: And the Most High shall appear upon the seat of judgment, and misery shall pass away, and the long suffering shall have an end:

quote: the earth shall restore those that are asleep in her, and so shall the dust those that dwell in silence, and the secret places shall deliver those souls that were committed unto them.
old: 2 Esdras 7:32 — *the earth shall restore those that are asleep in her, and so shall the dust those that dwell in silence, and the secret places shall deliver those souls that were committed unto them.* The wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the earth-shall-restore-those-that-are-asleep substance — the prophet Daniel's Daniel 12:2 substance carried-forward at the apocalyptic-wisdom-stream-register; the asleep-awaiting-the-resurrection substance the framework reads, NOT the inherited-Christian immediate-disembodied-soul substance.

other.text_db: But as touching the resurrection of the dead, have you not read that which was spoken unto you by Elohim (God), saying,
other.text_canon: But as touching the resurrection of the dead, have ye not read that which was spoken unto you by Elohim (God), saying,

apoc.text: He created me from the beginning before the world, and I shall never fail.
apoc.prev: So the Creator of all things gave me a commandment, and he that made me caused my tabernacle to rest, and said, Let your dwelling be in Jacob, and your inheritance in Yashar'el (Israel).
apoc.next: In the holy tabernacle I served before him; and so was I established in Sion.

quote: I came out of the mouth of the Most High
old: Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 24:9 (with 24:3, *I came out of the mouth of the Most High*) — *he created me from the beginning before the world, and I shall never fail.* Wisdom's own from-eternity testimony, created before the world and dwelling in Ya'aqov (Jacob) and Yashar'el (Israel); John 8:58's *Before Abraham was, I am* names the same eternity in the Formed Word who came to tabernacle among his own.

other.text_db: Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was, I am.
other.text_canon: Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was, I am.

apoc.text: And to him you gavest commandment to love your way: which he transgressed, and immediately you appointedst death in him and in his generations, of whom came nations, tribes, people, and kindreds, out of number.
apoc.prev: And you leadest him into paradise, which your right hand had planted, before ever the earth came forward.
apoc.next: And every people walked after their own will, and did wonderful things before you, and despised your commandments.

quote: appointed in him and in his generations, of whom came nations, tribes, people … out of number
old: 2 Esdras 3:7 — death *appointed in him and in his generations, of whom came nations, tribes, people … out of number* the reign of death from Adam over all his seed (Romans 5:14).

other.text_db: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam’s transgression, who is the figure of him that was to come.
other.text_canon: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam’s transgression, who is the figure of him that was to come.

apoc.text: And when we were carried away captives to Nineve, all my brothers and those that were of my kindred did eat of the bread of the Gentiles.
apoc.prev: Furthermore, when I was come to the age of a man, I married Anna of my own kindred, and of her I begat Tobias.
apoc.next: But I kept myself from eating;

quote: all my brethren … did eat of the bread of the Gentiles
old: Tobit 1:10 — *all my brethren … did eat of the bread of the Gentiles* the captive's case behind the weak who eateth herbs: the heathen table refused (Romans 14:2).

other.text_db: For one believes that he may eat all things: another, who is weak, eats herbs.
other.text_canon: For one believeth that he may eat all things: another, who is weak, eateth herbs.

apoc.text: Such things they did imagine, and were deceived: for their own wickedness has blinded them.
apoc.prev: Let us condemn him with a shameful death: for by his own saying he shall be respected.
apoc.next: As for the mysteries of Yahuah (God), they knew them not: neither hoped they for the wages of righteousness, nor discerned a reward for blameless souls.

quote: they were deceived: for their own wickedness has blinded them
old: Wisdom of Solomon 2:21 — *they were deceived: for their own wickedness has blinded them* the root of the world's false wisdom, which *Elohim (God) hath made foolish* (1 Corinthians 1:20).

other.text_db: Where is the wise? where is the scribe? where is the disputer of this world? has not Elohim (God) made foolish the wisdom of this world?
other.text_canon: Where is the wise? where is the scribe? where is the disputer of this world? hath not Elohim (God) made foolish the wisdom of this world?

apoc.text: For though they be punished in the sight of men, yet is their hope full of immortality.
apoc.prev: And their going from us to be utter destruction: but they are in peace.
apoc.next: And having been a little chastised, they shall be greatly rewarded: for Yahuah (God) proved them, and found them worthy for himself.

quote: their hope is full of immortality,
old: Wisdom of Solomon 3:4 — *their hope is full of immortality,* the reward of the righteous the ungodly *neither hoped... nor discerned* (Wisdom 2:22); the unseen *things which Elohim (God) hath prepared for them that love him* (1 Corinthians 2:9).

other.text_db: But as it is written, Eye has not seen, nor ear heard, neither have entered into the heart of man, the things which Elohim (God) has prepared for them that love him.
other.text_canon: But as it is written, Eye hath not seen, nor ear heard, neither have entered into the heart of man, the things which Elohim (God) hath prepared for them that love him.

apoc.text: After these years shall my son Messiah (Christ) die, and all men that have life.
apoc.prev: For my son the Messiah shall be revealed with those that be with him, and they that remain shall rejoice within four hundred years.
apoc.next: And the world shall be turned into the old silence seven days, like as in the former judgments: so that no man shall remain.

quote: my son Messiah (Christ) [shall] die, and all men that have life
old: 2 Esdras 7:29 — *my son Messiah (Christ) [shall] die, and all men that have life* the library's universal death, then the raising; *as in Adam all die, even so in Messiah all made alive* (1 Corinthians 15:22).

other.text_db: For as in Adam all die, even so in Messiah (Christ) shall all be made alive.
other.text_canon: For as in Adam all die, even so in Messiah (Christ) shall all be made alive.

apoc.text: But the souls of the righteous are in the hand of Yahuah (God), and there shall no torment touch them.
apoc.next: In the sight of the unwise they seemed to die: and their departure is taken for misery,

quote: the souls of the righteous are in the hand of Yahuah (God)... their hope is full of immortality
old: Wisdom of Solomon 3:1 — *the souls of the righteous are in the hand of Yahuah (God)... their hope is full of immortality* the seeming-death the sowing, immortality the raising; *sown in dishonour; raised in glory* (1 Corinthians 15:43).

other.text_db: So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption:
other.text_canon: So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption:

apoc.text: Surely vain are all men by nature, who are ignorant of Yahuah (God), and could not out of the good things that are seen know him that is: neither by considering the works did they acknowledge the workmaster;
apoc.next: But deemed either fire, or wind, or the swift air, or the circle of the stars, or the violent water, or the lights of heaven, to be the gods which govern the world.

quote: Surely vain are all men by nature, who are ignorant of God, and could not out of the good things that are seen know him that is: neither by considering the works did they acknowledge the workmaster;
old: Wisdom of Solomon 13:1 — *Surely vain are all men by nature, who are ignorant of God, and could not out of the good things that are seen know him that is: neither by considering the works did they acknowledge the workmaster;* the thesis that idolatry is 'the beginning, the cause, and the end, of all evil' (Wisdom of Solomon 14:27) completes the polemic begun in 13:1, the Creator unknown though seen — the very pairing Romans 1:20 and 1:25 draw on.

other.text_db: For the worshipping of idols not to be named is the beginning, the cause, and the end, of all evil.

apoc.text: He has commanded no man to do wickedly, neither has he given any man licence to sin.
apoc.prev: And his eyes are upon them that fear him, and he knoweth every work of man.

quote: no man licence to sin
old: James 1:15 — *Then when lust hath conceived, it bringeth forth sin: and sin, when it is finished, bringeth forth death.* Yahuah gave *no man licence to sin* (Sirach 15:20); sin is born of a man's own conceived lust, not of any divine warrant.

other.text_db: Then when lust has conceived, it brings forth sin: and sin, when it is finished, brings forth death.
other.text_canon: Then when lust hath conceived, it bringeth forth sin: and sin, when it is finished, bringeth forth death.

apoc.text: Accustom not your mouth to swearing; neither use thyself to the naming of the Holy One.
apoc.prev: The sinner shall be left in his foolishness: both the evil speaker and the proud shall fall thereby.
apoc.next: For as a servant that is continually beaten shall not be without a blue mark: so he that sweareth and nameth Yahuah (God) continually shall not be faultless.

quote: accustom not thy mouth to swearing; neither use thyself to the naming of the Holy One
old: Sirach 23:9 — *accustom not thy mouth to swearing; neither use thyself to the naming of the Holy One* the wisdom-library almost in James's words; not the oath abolished but the Name honored (James 5:12).

other.text_db: But above all things, my brethren, swear not, neither by heaven, neither by the earth, neither by any other oath: but let your yea be yea; and your nay, nay; lest you fall into condemnation.
other.text_canon: But above all things, my brethren, swear not, neither by heaven, neither by the earth, neither by any other oath: but let your yea be yea; and your nay, nay; lest ye fall into condemnation.

apoc.text: My son, in your sickness be not negligent: but pray to Yahuah (God), and he will make you whole.
apoc.prev: Of such does the apothecary make a confection; and of his works there is no end; and from him is peace over all the earth,
apoc.next: Leave off from sin, and order yours hands aright, and cleanse your heart from all wickedness.

quote: in thy sickness... pray unto Yahuah (God), and he will make thee whole
old: Sirach 38:9 — *in thy sickness... pray unto Yahuah (God), and he will make thee whole* the wisdom-library's medicine of the soul; *Is any sick among you? let him... pray* (James 5:14).

other.text_db: Is any sick among you? let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord:
other.text_canon: Is any sick among you? let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of Yahuah (Lord):

apoc.text: For alms does deliver from death, and shall purge away all sin. Those that exercise alms and righteousness shall be filled with life:
apoc.prev: Prayer is good with fasting and alms and righteousness. A little with righteousness is better than much with unrighteousness. It is better to give alms than to lay up gold:
apoc.next: But they that sin are enemies to their own life.

quote: alms doth deliver from death, and shall purge away all sin
old: Tobit 12:9 — *alms doth deliver from death, and shall purge away all sin* righteous love that delivers from death; *shall save a soul from death* (James 5:20).

other.text_db: Let him know, that he which converteth the sinner from the error of his way shall save a soul from death, and shall hide a multitude of sins.
other.text_canon: Let him know, that he which converteth the sinner from the error of his way shall save a soul from death, and shall hide a multitude of sins.

apoc.text: And have delivered me, according to the multitude of your mercies and greatness of your name, from the teeth of them that were ready to devour me, and out of the hands of such as sought after my life, and from the manifold afflictions which I had;
apoc.prev: For you are my defender and helper, and has preserved my body from destruction, and from the snare of the slanderous tongue, and from the lips that forge lies, and has been my helper against my adversaries:
apoc.next: From the choking of fire on every side, and from the midst of the fire which I kindled not;

quote: delivered me... by the greatness of your name... out of the hands of such as sought after my life
old: ★ *delivered me... by the greatness of your name... out of the hands of such as sought after my life* (Sirach 51:3) — delivered by the Name (54:1) from those who *seek after my soul* (54:3).

other.text_db: For he has delivered me out of all trouble: and my eye has seen his desire upon my enemies.
other.text_canon: For he hath delivered me out of all trouble: and mine eye hath seen his desire upon mine enemies.

apoc.text: And wisdom was with you: which knoweth your works, and was present when you madest the world, and knew what was acceptable in your sight, and right in your commandments.
apoc.prev: You have commanded me to build a temple upon your holy mount, and an altar in the city in which you dwellest, a resemblance of the holy tabernacle, which you have prepared from the beginning.
apoc.next: O send her out of your holy heavens, and from the throne of your glory, that being present she may labour with me, that I may know what is pleasing to you.

quote: was present when thou madest the world
old: *was present when thou madest the world* (Wisdom of Solomon 9:9) — *When he prepared the heavens, I was there* (8:27): the Formed Son present at the making.

other.text_db: When he prepared the heavens, I was there: when he set a compass upon the face of the depth:
other.text_canon: When he prepared the heavens, I was there: when he set a compass upon the face of the depth:

apoc.text: But the souls of the righteous are in the hand of Yahuah (God), and there shall no torment touch them.
apoc.next: In the sight of the unwise they seemed to die: and their departure is taken for misery,

quote: the souls of the righteous are in the hand of Yahuah (God)... in the time of their visitation they shall shine
old: ★ *the souls of the righteous are in the hand of Yahuah (God)... in the time of their visitation they shall shine* (Wisdom 3:1,7) — the end seen in the sanctuary (73:17): the righteous held safe, only seeming to die.

other.text_db: Until I went into the sanctuary of Elohim (God); then understood I their end.
other.text_canon: Until I went into the sanctuary of Elohim (God); then understood I their end.

apoc.text: A faithfull friend is a strong defence: and he that has found such an one has found a treasure.
apoc.prev: Separate thyself from your enemies, and take heed of your friends.
apoc.next: Nothing does countervail a faithful friend, and his excellency is invaluable.

quote: A faithful friend is a strong defence... has found a treasure
old: *A faithful friend is a strong defence... has found a treasure* (Sirach 6:14) — the restored witness echoes 18:24; the true friend is a fortress and a treasure found.

other.text_db: A man that has friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.
other.text_canon: A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.

apoc.text: Instead of which you feddest your own people with angels’ food, and did send them from heaven bread prepared without their labour, able to content every man’s delight, and agreeing to every taste.
apoc.prev: And at another time it burneth even in the midst of water above the power of fire, that it might destroy the fruits of an unjust land.
apoc.next: For your sustenance declared your sweetness to your children, and serving to the appetite of the eater, tempered itself to every man’s liking.

quote: thou feddest thy own people with angels' food... bread prepared without their labour
old: ★ *thou feddest thy own people with angels' food... bread prepared without their labour* (Wisdom of Solomon 16:20) — the restored wisdom sings the very phrase of 78:25.

other.text_db: Man did eat angels’ food: he sent them meat to the full.
other.text_canon: Man did eat angels’ food: he sent them meat to the full.

apoc.text: Wherefore they thought to destroy the generation of Jacob that was among them, and thereupon they began to slay and destroy the people.
apoc.prev: Now when the nations round about heard that the altar was built and the sanctuary renewed as before, it displeased them very much.
apoc.next: Then Judas fought against the children of Esau in Idumea at Arabattine, because they besieged Gael: and he gave them a great overthrow, and abated their courage, and took their spoils.

quote: they thought to destroy the generation of Jacob... and began to slay and destroy the people
old: ★ *they thought to destroy the generation of Jacob... and began to slay and destroy the people* (1 Maccabees 5:2) — the very plot of 83:4 to cut the people off from being a nation.

other.text_db: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Yashar'el (Israel) may be no more in remembrance.
other.text_canon: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Yashar'el (Israel) may be no more in remembrance.

apoc.text: O blessed are they which love you, for they shall rejoice in your peace: blessed are they which have been sorrowful for all your scourges; for they shall rejoice for you, when they have seen all your glory, and shall be glad for ever.
apoc.prev: Rejoice and be glad for the children of the just: for they shall be gathered together, and shall bless Yahuah (God) of the just.
apoc.next: Let my soul bless Yahuah (God) the great King.

quote: O blessed are they which love thee, for they shall rejoice in thy peace... and shall be glad for ever
old: ★ *O blessed are they which love thee, for they shall rejoice in thy peace... and shall be glad for ever* (Tobit 13:14) — Tobit, praying from captivity, sings the same blessing on Jerusalem's lovers that 122:6 pronounces.

other.text_db: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: they shall prosper that love you.
other.text_canon: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: they shall prosper that love thee.

apoc.text: So shall all nations praise Yahuah (God), and his people shall confess Yahuah (God), and Yahuah (God) shall exalt his people; and all those which love Yahuah (God) in truth and justice shall rejoice, shewing mercy to our brothers.
apoc.prev: And all nations shall turn, and fear Yahuah (God) truly, and shall bury their idols.
apoc.next: And now, my son, depart out of Nineve, because that those things which the prophet Jonas spoke shall surely come to pass.

quote: all nations shall praise Yahuah (God), and his people shall confess Yahuah (God), and Yahuah (God) shall exalt his people
old: ★ *all nations shall praise Yahuah (God), and his people shall confess Yahuah (God), and Yahuah (God) shall exalt his people* (Tobit 14:7) — the nations come IN to His people (Zechariah 8:23); His people exalted, not replaced.

other.text_db: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); In those days it shall come to pass, that ten men shall take hold out of all languages of the nations, even shall take hold of the skirt of him that is a Yahudi (Jew), saying, We will go with you: for we have heard that Elohim (God) is with you.
other.text_canon: Thus saith Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); In those days it shall come to pass, that ten men shall take hold out of all languages of the nations, even shall take hold of the skirt of him that is a Yahudi (Jew), saying, We will go with you: for we have heard that Elohim (God) is with you.

apoc.text: And entered into it the three and twentieth day of the second month in the hundred seventy and first year, with thanksgiving, and branches of palm trees, and with harps, and cymbals, and with viols, and hymns, and songs: because there was destroyed a great enemy out of Yashar'el (Israel).
apoc.prev: Then cried they to Simon, beseeching him to be at one with them: which thing he granted them; and when he had put them out from thence, he cleansed the tower from pollutions:
apoc.next: He ordained also that that day should be kept every year with gladness. Moreover the hill of the temple that was by the tower he made stronger than it was, and there he dwelt himself with his company.

quote: entered into it... with branches of palm trees... and hymns, and songs
old: ★ *entered into it... with branches of palm trees... and hymns, and songs* (1 Maccabees 13:51) — the palm-branch entry into Jerusalem; the rejoicing the daughter of Zion would pour on her true King (Zechariah 9:9).

other.text_db: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, your King comes unto you: he is just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, and upon a colt the foal of an ass.
other.text_canon: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, thy King cometh unto thee: he is just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, and upon a colt the foal of an ass.

apoc.text: That your children, O Yahuah (God), whom you lovest, might know, that it is not the growing of fruits that nourishes man: but that it is your word, which preserves them that put their trust in you.
apoc.prev: Therefore even then was it altered into all fashions, and was obedient to your grace, that nourishes all things, according to the desire of them that had need:
apoc.next: For that which was not destroyed of the fire, being warmed with a little sunbeam, soon melted away:

quote: it is not the growing of fruits that nourisheth man: but... thy word, which preserveth them that put their trust in thee.
old: Wisdom of Solomon 16:26 — *it is not the growing of fruits that nourisheth man: but... thy word, which preserveth them that put their trust in thee.* The Father who marks the sparrow preserves His own.

other.text_db: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father.
other.text_canon: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father.

apoc.text: Honour your father with your whole heart, and forget not the sorrows of your mother.
apoc.prev: Have you a wife after your mind? forsake her not: but give not thyself over to a light woman.
apoc.next: Remember that you were begotten of them; and how can you recompense them the things that they have done for you?

quote: Honour thy father with thy whole heart, and forget not the sorrows of thy mother.
old: Sirach 7:27-28 — *Honour thy father with thy whole heart, and forget not the sorrows of thy mother.* The fifth word is never abolished; *love me more* is an ordering of loves, not a cancelling.

other.text_db: He that loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me: and he that loves son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me.
other.text_canon: He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me: and he that loveth son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me.

apoc.text: Set not yours heart upon goods unjustly gotten, for they shall not profit you in the day of calamity.
apoc.prev: Make no tarrying to turn to Yahuah (God), and put not off from day to day: for suddenly shall the wrath of Yahuah (God) come forth, and in your security you shall be destroyed, and perish in the day of vengeance.
apoc.next: Winnow not with every wind, and go not into every way: for so does the sinner that has a double tongue.

quote: Set not your heart upon goods unjustly gotten, for they shall not profit you in the day of calamity
old: ★ *Set not your heart upon goods unjustly gotten, for they shall not profit you in the day of calamity* (Sirach 5:8) — the banquet *removed* (Amos 6:7) when the calamity comes.

other.text_db: Therefore now shall they go captive with the first that go captive, and the banquet of them that stretched themselves shall be removed.
other.text_canon: Therefore now shall they go captive with the first that go captive, and the banquet of them that stretched themselves shall be removed.

apoc.text: And he will scourge us for our iniquities, and will have mercy again, and will gather us out of all nations, among whom he has scattered us.
apoc.prev: There declare his greatness, and extol him before all the living: for he is our Elohim (God), and he is Yahuah (God) our Father for ever.
apoc.next: If you turn to him with your whole heart, and with your whole mind, and deal uprightly before him, then will he turn to you, and will not hide his face from you. Therefore see what he will do with you, and confess him with your whole mouth, and praise Yahuah (God) of might, and extol the everlasting King. In the land of my captivity do I praise him, and declare his might and majesty to a sinful nation. O you sinners, turn and do justice before him: who can tell if he will accept you, and have mercy on you?

quote: he will gather us out of all nations, among whom he has scattered us
old: ★ *he will gather us out of all nations, among whom he has scattered us* (Tobit 13:5) — the regathering *from sea to sea* (Micah 7:12) is the two-house people brought home.

other.text_db: In that day also he shall come even to you from Assyria, and from the fortified cities, and from the fortress even to the river, and from sea to sea, and from mountain to mountain.
other.text_canon: In that day also he shall come even to thee from Assyria, and from the fortified cities, and from the fortress even to the river, and from sea to sea, and from mountain to mountain.

apoc.text: The countries marvelled at you for your songs, and proverbs, and parables, and interpretations.
apoc.prev: Your name went far to the islands; and for your peace you were beloved.
apoc.next: By the name of Yahuah (God), which is called Yahuah (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), you did gather gold as tin and did multiply silver as lead.

quote: The countries marvelled at thee for thy songs, and proverbs, and parables, and interpretations.
old: Sirach 47:17 — *The countries marvelled at thee for thy songs, and proverbs, and parables, and interpretations.* The library remembers the fame that drew the nations to Solomon; yet a greater than Solomon is here.

other.text_db: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and condemn them: for she came from the utmost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.
other.text_canon: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and condemn them: for she came from the utmost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.

apoc.text: Then Judas fought against the children of Esau in Idumea at Arabattine, because they besieged Gael: and he gave them a great overthrow, and abated their courage, and took their spoils.
apoc.prev: Wherefore they thought to destroy the generation of Jacob that was among them, and thereupon they began to slay and destroy the people.
apoc.next: Also he remembered the injury of the children of Bean, who had been a snare and an offence to the people, in that they lay in wait for them in the ways.

quote: Judas fought against the children of Esau in Idumea... and gave them a great overthrow
old: ★ *Judas fought against the children of Esau in Idumea... and gave them a great overthrow* (1 Maccabees 5:3) — the recompense returns on the brother-line; the deed done to Jacob repaid (Obadiah 1:10).

other.text_db: For your violence against your brother Jacob shame shall cover you, and you shall be cut off for ever.
other.text_canon: For thy violence against thy brother Jacob shame shall cover thee, and thou shalt be cut off for ever.

apoc.text: Instead of which you gavest them a burning pillar of fire, both to be a guide of the unknown journey, and an harmless sun to entertain them honourably.
apoc.prev: But for that they did not hurt them now, of whom they had been wronged before, they thanked them, and besought them pardon for that they had been enemies.
apoc.next: For they were worthy to be deprived of light and imprisoned in darkness, who had kept your sons shut up, by whom the uncorrupt light of the law was to be given to the world.

quote: thou gavest them a burning pillar of fire, both to be a guide of the unknown journey
old: ★ *thou gavest them a burning pillar of fire, both to be a guide of the unknown journey* (Wisdom of Solomon 18:3) — the restored witness to the *fire by night* that led the son (Deuteronomy 1:33).

other.text_db: Who went in the way before you, to search you out a place to pitch your tents in, in fire by night, to shew you by what way you should go, and in a cloud by day.
other.text_canon: Who went in the way before you, to search you out a place to pitch your tents in, in fire by night, to shew you by what way ye should go, and in a cloud by day.

apoc.text: Be as a father to the fatherless, and instead of an husband to their mother: so shall you be as the son of the Most High, and he shall love you more than your mother does.
apoc.prev: Deliver him that suffers wrong from the hand of the oppressor; and be not fainthearted when you sittest in judgment.
apoc.next: Wisdom exalteth her children, and layeth hold of them that seek her.

quote: Be as a father to the fatherless... so shalt thou be as the son of the Most High.
old: *Be as a father to the fatherless... so shalt thou be as the son of the Most High.* (Sirach 4:10) — the wisdom tradition names Job's deed as the mark of a true son.

other.text_db: I was a father to the poor: and the cause which I knew not I searched out.
other.text_canon: I was a father to the poor: and the cause which I knew not I searched out.

apoc.text: So shall all nations praise Yahuah (God), and his people shall confess Yahuah (God), and Yahuah (God) shall exalt his people; and all those which love Yahuah (God) in truth and justice shall rejoice, shewing mercy to our brothers.
apoc.prev: And all nations shall turn, and fear Yahuah (God) truly, and shall bury their idols.
apoc.next: And now, my son, depart out of Nineve, because that those things which the prophet Jonas spoke shall surely come to pass.

quote: all nations shall praise Yahuah (God), and his people shall confess Yahuah (God), and Yahuah (God) shall exalt his people
old: *all nations shall praise Yahuah (God), and his people shall confess Yahuah (God), and Yahuah (God) shall exalt his people* (Tobit 14:7) — the ingathering of the stranger does not displace the people; both rejoice (1 Kings 8:43).

other.text_db: Hear you in heaven your dwelling place, and do according to all that the stranger calls to you for: that all people of the earth may know your name, to fear you, as do your people Yashar'el (Israel); and that they may know that this house, which I have builded, is called by your name.
other.text_canon: Hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place, and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for: that all people of the earth may know thy name, to fear thee, as do thy people Yashar'el (Israel); and that they may know that this house, which I have builded, is called by thy name.

apoc.text: O send her out of your holy heavens, and from the throne of your glory, that being present she may labour with me, that I may know what is pleasing to you.
apoc.prev: And wisdom was with you: which knoweth your works, and was present when you madest the world, and knew what was acceptable in your sight, and right in your commandments.
apoc.next: For she knoweth and understands all things, and she shall lead me soberly in my doings, and preserve me in her power.

quote: O send her out of your holy heavens, and from the throne of your glory... that she may labour with me
old: *O send her out of your holy heavens, and from the throne of your glory... that she may labour with me* (Wisdom of Solomon 9:10) — wisdom descends from Yahuah's throne to enable the shepherd-king.

other.text_db: Give me now wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people: for who can judge this your people, that is so great?
other.text_canon: Give me now wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people: for who can judge this thy people, that is so great?

apoc.text: Now therefore I bow the knee of my heart, beseeching you of grace.
apoc.prev: I am bowed down with many iron bands, that I cannot lift up my head, neither have any release: for I have provoked your wrath, and done evil before you: I did not your will, neither kept I your commandments: I have set up abominations, and have multiplied offences.
apoc.next: I have sinned, O Yahuah (God), I have sinned, and I acknowledge my iniquities:

quote: I bow the knee of my heart... for you are Yahuah (God) of them that repent
old: Prayer of Manasseh 1:11-14 (apocrypha) — the very prayer attributed to him: *I bow the knee of my heart... for you are Yahuah (God) of them that repent*.

other.text_db: And prayed unto him: and he was intreated of him, and heard his supplication, and brought him again to Jerusalem into his kingdom. Then Manasseh knew that Yahuah (LORD) he was Elohim (God).
other.text_canon: And prayed unto him: and he was intreated of him, and heard his supplication, and brought him again to Jerusalem into his kingdom. Then Manasseh knew that Yahuah (LORD) he was Elohim (God).

apoc.text: Instead of which you feddest your own people with angels’ food, and did send them from heaven bread prepared without their labour, able to content every man’s delight, and agreeing to every taste.
apoc.prev: And at another time it burneth even in the midst of water above the power of fire, that it might destroy the fruits of an unjust land.
apoc.next: For your sustenance declared your sweetness to your children, and serving to the appetite of the eater, tempered itself to every man’s liking.

quote: thou feddest thy own people with angels' food... bread prepared without their labour
old: Wisdom of Solomon 16:20 — *thou feddest thy own people with angels' food... bread prepared without their labour*: the restored witness names the manna (Nehemiah 9:20).

other.text_db: You gave also your good spirit to instruct them, and withheldest not your manna from their mouth, and gave them water for their thirst.
other.text_canon: Thou gavest also thy good spirit to instruct them, and withheldest not thy manna from their mouth, and gavest them water for their thirst.

apoc.text: Therefore is Yahuah (God) patient with them, and poureth forth his mercy upon them.
apoc.prev: As a drop of water to the sea, and a gravelstone in comparison of the sand; so are a thousand years to the days of eternity.
apoc.next: He saw and perceived their end to be evil; therefore he multiplied his compassion.

quote: Yahuah (God) is patient with them, and poureth forth his mercy upon them
old: Ecclesiasticus (Sirach) 18:11 — *Yahuah (God) is patient with them, and poureth forth his mercy upon them*: the restored wisdom witnesses Nehemiah 9:17.

other.text_db: And refused to obey, neither were mindful of your wonders that you did among them; but hardened their necks, and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage: but you are a Elohim (God) ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and forsookest them not.
other.text_canon: And refused to obey, neither were mindful of thy wonders that thou didst among them; but hardened their necks, and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage: but thou art a Elohim (God) ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and forsookest them not.
